notes.title: The MOST SPECIAL update to the DEMO EVER! (Also 1,000 Subscribers on Youtube).
notes.notes:
In celebration of a new demo and 1,000 subscribers on Youtube, I would like to announce the most special of all special updates to the demo and the upcoming full game of "Date Time".

That's right...

[previewyoutube=I6YtlWKLotE;full][/previewyoutube]

iiiiiit's a GAME CURSOR!

The ultimate addition to "Date Time", a GAME CURSOR reminiscient of the Classic Mac OS.  This has been a long time coming, I have spent a gazillion hours trying to figure out how to do this via code or hacking or telepathy... but then realized all I had to do was drag 'n' drop an image into the 'cursor' box in Unity.  



Oh... also some fixes:


Version 2.1b:



-Reworked text printers to be completely static to prevent text jittering, rapid unintentional skipping or artifacting.  If you're still having problems, please contact me at https://www.cattrigger.com/links.


-Solved bug where players who go to Petya before completing the Melissa Chapter would come upon a black screen when returning to Petya.


-FIxed a graphical error near the end of the Anna Chapter Preview where a graphic that changed, flashes back to its initial state for a brief moment.

notes.title: Date Time Demo v2.1 Changelog - Small Fixes,
notes.notes:
Thanks again for everyone who has played the Date Time Demo, so far.  Here are a few fixes due to player feedback:

Date Time Demo v2.1

1 - Standardized Text to prevent breaking text printers in the game.  

If you are still experiencing odd text printer errors, such as screens auto-skipping text, text seemingly being cut-off from the screen, or text seeming like excerpts being the only things shown on the screen, please delete your save profiles at:

WINDOWS: 

C:\Users\[Your Name]\AppData\LocalLow\CatTrigger\Date Time Demo

MAC:

~/Library/Application Support/com.CatTrigger.Date-Time-Demo

LINUX:

.config/unity3d/CatTrigger/Date Time Demo

2 - Fixed an error where visiting PETya before completing the Melissa chapter leads to a black screen when re-entering PETya's section.

Please let me know if there are any other errors you might've bumped into.  Thank you so much!

NOTE:

As reported by some Mac Users via the Non-Steam version of the Demo, please check your app security settings to make sure it allows for unauthorized or non-app store related applications to run.

If you are still unsure how to do it, please use Steam to download the Mac version.

notes.title: Upcoming Demo Update - Anna / Melissa Alt-Path
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Part 1 of the Date Time❤️ demo.
Over 5,000 downloads and counting! 

Wow!    Melissa was SO THRILLED to have another go, a new upgrade to her systems and the ability to play with her new toys. Think of this enhanced version as the expectation going forward for both dates with Morris & Anna. 




 Speaking of Anna...

https://i.imgur.com/bQZ7hew.png

Let's talk a bit about the upcoming demo update.



You've dated the bookish Melissa... and maybe even the shy Morris. But Anna is a different person from both.

She's outgoing. She's confident. And she'll do everything possible to get what she wants.

Anna brings forth a dating adventure that eclipses both Morris & Melissa in length, intrigue, and challenge.



https://i.imgur.com/RA4ZaDE.png

Explore the ever growing idyllic town of Date Time❤. You're not just going to the park to look for swans, or eating a delicious strawberry salad at the cafe. You've got places to go, people to see... and quests to complete to help build your friendships with the town folk.

https://i.imgur.com/cA1aqZW.jpg



Meet with the local sports enthusiasts at the Recreational Center, talk politics with the Mayor of the town at City Hall, and if your car's broken, get it repaired at [ENTITY NOT FOUND]

But, at the end of the day, you'll be meeting up with Anna at the overlook of the town: MT. SALVATION.

If you play your cards right, she'll give you an eternal smooch, a final end to this beautiful trilogy of ours!

Anna will capture your heart in ways Morris... or even Melissa... CAN'T.

https://i.imgur.com/TFwu8Rr.png


Speaking of Melissa...
...we've heard you. You want a different ending. Maybe an even happier one with our original ol' shareware gal?

Don't worry. You will. 

A [VERY IMPORTANT PERSON] is going to help you with that, don't be nervous. We can do it together.

I have FAITH.


Get these updates earlier along with a FREE desktop wallpaper and more goodies by signing up to the Newsletter.
